literalContractRisk: CP1-25 asks for an INSERT committed while its marker fails, then23505 recovery. A fixture manually made legacy/unmarked is separate scope and cannot be silently substituted.
nextAllowedWork: Run only independently valid rollback/retry in released new scratch; retain post-commit/23505 branch as contract review or explicitly labelled legacy fixture. Do not disable production atomicity or delete original durable receipts to manufacture PASS.
